findings.source: ERC20Helper.transferFrom(oldToken, msg.sender, address(this), oldTokenAmount_) -> _call(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20Like.transferFrom.selector, from, to, amount)) -> token.call(data)
findings.issue: The abi.encodeWithSelector buffer is built with unaligned split stores (the selector 0x23b872dd in decimal) and copied by a constant 100-byte while loop, so the low-level call shows raw memory instead of transferFrom(caller, this, _pid) (and the transfer call likewise).
findings.rule: Merge adjacent byte-range stores into whole words (mem[160 len 4] = sel, then words at 164 ...); a word-copy loop of constant length is a copy line; with both, the call buffer is sel ++ args and the call prints with its selector and arguments.
